title: mw.config.changed.v1
description: Dynamic business config change, broadcast after maker-checker approval (spec 20.4). Compacted topic keyed by configKey: the latest record per key is the current value; services hold an in-memory snapshot and swap it atomically. A DELETE is followed by a tombstone.

version.description: Monotonic per configKey; consumers ignore a version older than the one they hold.

value.description: Full new value (not a diff); never contains secret values, only Vault paths.

BillerValue.description: BILLER value (ticket 113, FRS FL-04, FL-05, ADM-05): one biller catalogue entry, configKey biller/<code>. mw-adapter-billpay keeps a read projection; mw-orchestrator enforces amountRule. A disabled biller is refused with maintenanceEn/maintenanceBn (PLT-043).

regex.description: Java regex in a strict grammar checked by mw-admin-api: optional ^, atoms (literal, [class], \d, \w, \s, .) each with at most one quantifier (?, *, +, {n}, {m,n} with n <= 64), optional $; no groups, alternation, backreferences or lookarounds; at most 8 quantifiers, at most one of them variable-width (the rest {n}). Consumers match at most 64 characters of input.

amountRule.description: FIXED: the paid amount equals the fetched amount; MINIMUM: at least minAmountMinor; OPEN: within minAmountMinor..maxAmountMinor (each bound optional).

PartnerValue.description: PARTNER value: the adapters' partner record (spec 12.1, ADR D28), every field optional at this level; the adapter that owns the family checks the whole record and reports LIVE / REJECTED on mw.partner.route.status.v1. Additive fields of ticket 83: route, mappings, allowedHosts, family, dryRun. The old shape (template, operations) is gone since ticket 84 and refused. A record whose changedBy is system/rollback republishes the newest LIVE version after the current one was REJECTED (ticket 84).

family.description: The adapter that applies the record; the others skip it.

route.description: The partner's Camel YAML DSL route from direct:partner-<id>, built from the mw-* Kamelets.

allowedHosts.description: The hosts the route may call (guardrail 4).

dryRun.description: The dry-run the version must pass before it goes live: operation sent with sample (the canonical PartnerCall input) through the candidate route, against baseUrl (a partner sandbox; must be in allowedHosts) or the environment's simulator.

maintenance.description: In maintenance now, until cleared (ticket 97); calls refused MW-SYS-PARTNER_MAINTENANCE (ticket 131b).

healthCheck.description: The route has a HEALTH_CHECK branch, probed on a schedule (ticket 97).

maintenanceWindow.description: Ticket 131b: from start (absent: now) until end (absent: until cleared), the bn/en message of the refusal.

endpoint.description: Ticket 131b: the selected endpoint profile; the route's url={{endpoint}} is filled from endpoints[endpoint].

endpoints.description: Ticket 131b: base URL per endpoint profile.
